title: Paul's Ministry in Ephesus
description: Paulus arrives in Ephesus and meets some disciples who only knew John's baptism. He baptizes them in the name of Jesus, and when he lays hands on them, the Holy Spirit comes upon them, and they speak in tongues and prophesy. Paul preaches in the synagogue for three months, then daily at Tyrannus' school for two years, so that all Asia hears the word of the Lord. God performs extraordinary miracles through him, so that even handkerchiefs that had touched him healed the sick and drove out evil spirits. The seven sons of Sceva tried in vain to use the name of Jesus, but were overpowered by the evil spirit. Many turned away, confessed their deeds, and publicly burned their magic books, and the word of the Lord grew mightily.

versions.title: Paul's Ministry in Ephesus
versions.description: Paul arrives in Ephesus, baptizes disciples, and lays hands on them so they receive the Holy Spirit. He preaches for over two years with great power; evil spirits are driven out, many turn to God, and burn their magic books, so that the Lord's word grows mightily.
